name: restaurant-platform
description: Tenant-branded restaurant web and Android applications with a shared Spring Boot API and Supabase

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @restaurant-platform/shared-types && npm run build -w @restaurant-platform/ui-tokens && npm run build -w @restaurant-platform/api-client && npm run build -w @restaurant-platform/restaurant-config --if-present
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @restaurant-platform/admin-web && npm run build -w @restaurant-platform/guest-web
scripts.build:mobile:starter: npm run build:packages && npm run build:starter -w @restaurant-platform/operations-mobile && npm run build:starter -w @restaurant-platform/customer-mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: eslint scripts eslint.config.mjs && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify:frontend: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build:web && npm run build:mobile:starter
